verdicts.reason: A keeps the original structure: the starburst badge sits top-left on the same left edge as the headline, the headline reflows to two lines and dominates, and the figure anchors the right. Its flaws are a tight ~30px left margin and some empty space at the bottom left. In B the 'TRY NOW' badge floats near the top centre, sharing no edge with the headline. That orphans it from the copy and breaks the grid. B's headline also runs close to the figure's bag, which makes the right side feel cramped.
